## Summary

I spent four years as a civil engineer and four years advising property investors, and along the way I noticed the best decisions were the ones backed by data. That led me to a Master of Business Analytics, where I’m building technical expertise in exploring, analysing and visualising data in R. Now I want to pair it with the business acumen and client communication skills I’ve developed over eight years of work.
